articles.summary: Robin is a systems engineer on the High-Power Stationary team at Plug. She helps design, test, and improve the 1 MW and 1.5 MW GenSure systems that Plug has developed and deployed. Her work ranges from reviewing PLC code to system level testing and field sign offs.
articles.title: H2@Work Employee Spotlight: Robin Willick

articles.summary: By building and operating the largest green hydrogen plant in the U.S., Plug has not only delivered on production but also validated the strength of our own GenEco electrolyzer technology.
articles.title: Plug’s Georgia Green Hydrogen Plant Achieves Record-Breaking Month
